articles.headline: Fort Technology furnishes September 2026 interim financial statements and MD&A
sourceWarnings: Financial results are unaudited; financing capacity is conditional. No archived pre-entry article version was obtained.
articles.summary: The filing reports nine-month revenue of $11.981 million and operating loss of $1.820 million. It also describes a conditional convertible-note facility of up to $20 million; this is not confirmation that the full facility was funded.
articles.timestampEvidence: StockTitan explicitly reports EDGAR availability November 16 at 04:46 PM EST, following acceptance at 04:45 PM EST. Public availability is used conservatively.

articles.headline: Fort Technology Reports Record Year-to-Date Revenues of $12 Million, Up 49%, and Record Year-to-Date Gross Profit of $2.1 Million
sourceWarnings: Direct GlobeNewswire retrieval was inaccessible; the issuer release was reviewed through Finviz and StockTitan reproductions. No price causation is established.
articles.summary: Fort announces unaudited nine-month revenue of $11.981 million and gross profit of $2.092 million. Operating loss widened to $1.820 million. The underlying results were already furnished November 16; the later release is a separate publication on the same event.
articles.timestampEvidence: StockTitan reproduces the issuer release with explicit November 17 07:32 AM EST. Finviz corroborates 07:32. The 07:58 EST Form 6-K reproduces this release and is merged rather than counted again.

articles.headline: Nexera: Subsidiary Fort Technology Reports 49% Growth with Record $12 Million Year-to-Date Revenues, Advancing Toward Milestones for Additional Fort Shares
sourceWarnings: The release financial-statement link points to the parent CIK, not Fort. Conditional financing and contingent shares are not treated as completed transactions.
articles.summary: Fort's controlling shareholder separately reports the results and conditional additional-share milestones. Financing and revenue targets remain conditions, not completed achievements. Its embedded financial-statement link points to Nexera CIK 1885408 rather than Fort CIK 2092967; Fort's financials were checked separately.
articles.timestampEvidence: StockTitan reproduces the Nexera release with explicit November 17 07:47 AM EST; MarketChameleon corroborates 07:47.

limitations: Partial source review, not exhaustive archive coverage or evidence of price causation. No archived pre-entry body obtained.
Nexera release links to parent CIK instead of Fort; the discrepancy remains prominent in sourceWarnings. Direct GlobeNewswire page inaccessible.

profile.historical_note: Reviewed November 17, 2026. Ontario continuation effective April 30, 2026; Nasdaq trading began June 8, 2026. UK operating concentration coexists with US expansion.
profile.notes: SEC cover and November 16 financials/MD&A reviewed. The stale SEC entity index reports British Columbia; the filing confirms continuation into Ontario on April 30, 2026. Supplemental sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2092967/000118518526005475/fortex99-1.htm ; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2092967/000118518526005475/fortex99-2.htm
profile.operations_basis: Reviewed principal operating base: UK warehouses and staff; September 2026 UK customer revenue is 9.883 of 11.981 million USD. US Logia expansion is disclosed separately and does not establish Canada as the operating country.
profile.security_basis: SEC registration cover lists FRTT common shares on Nasdaq; direct equity, not ADS/ADR.
